mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or the mean return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 2000 thousand units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 108.0 index level signals weakening real economic activity and declining corporate output, which reduces earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 108.0, or the mean return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both personal consumption expenditures and residential construction signals robust aggregate demand, which strengthens corporate revenue outlooks and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances where both PAYEMS and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 197.5 combined with a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20d returns in less than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 197.5 and FEDFUNDS <= 4.2%, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls signals a labor market that is both tightening and expanding, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS > 134000, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures above 350,000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 350000, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
